purpose: Continue the internet scan of the 18 states newly introduced by 12345->14523, promote an exact theoretical Rh III physical-value intersection with subtype preserved, and route scientifically useful identifier collisions into Worldshepherd rather than discarding them.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, authoritative dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, derivative copies, repeated records, and alternate landing pages are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Search co-occurrence, DOI suffixes, repository identifiers, file-bin boundaries, product numbers, catalog records, and similar collisions are not Glob evidence unless an independently verified physical quantity in a declared unit family is established.

sources.title: The Configurations 4dn + 4dn-1 5s in Doubly-Ionized Atoms of the Palladium Group
sources.author: Yehuda Shadmi
sources.authority: National Bureau of Standards / Journal of Research
sources.note: Use as a historical theoretical atomic-structure benchmark across the third spectra of the palladium group. The paper explicitly predicts hundreds of energy levels by interpolation of interaction parameters and distinguishes observed from calculated levels.

sources.title: Raman investigation of structural photoinduced irreversible changes of Ga10Ge25S65 chalcogenide glasses
sources.authority: Journal of Optoelectronics and Advanced Materials / UNESP repository record
sources.note: Use the before/after Raman and infrared characterization of above-band-gap-light-induced bonding changes in Ga-Ge-S glass as a photoresponsive-material validation precedent. The generated 33295 state is the repository handle identifier, not a Raman shift or other physical quantity.

sources.title: Folding and Unfolding in the Blue Copper Protein Rusticyanin: Role of the Oxidation State
sources.authors: Luis A. Alcaraz; Javier Gomez; Pablo Ramirez
sources.authority: International Journal of Molecular Sciences / PubMed Central
sources.note: Retain as a hard scientific-metadata negative control: 54232 is the article identifier, not a physical-value match. The source itself is legitimate science, which makes it useful for testing that scientific context alone cannot promote identifier collisions.

sources.title: Neutron spectroscopy of fullerite hydrogenated under high pressures
sources.note: Use high-pressure hydrogenation plus inelastic-neutron-scattering methodology as a materials-characterization precedent. The 01403 target occurs only inside the DOI/PII identifier and carries M1 metadata weight, not physical Glob evidence.

evidence_updates.claims_boundary: Table 13 lists Rh III d6s (3D)2D J=3/2 with no observed value and G.L.S. calculated energy 77596 cm^-1. Count only as a theoretical/calculated physical-value intersection; it is not an experimental measurement and does not prove predictive significance of the permutation.
33295 is the repository handle and not a reported Raman/IR physical value.
54232 is an article identifier, not a physical measurement.
01403 occurs in the DOI/PII identifier; the actual neutron-spectroscopy features are at different energies.

information_updates.finding: ExoMol/line-list infrastructures use 03100 as a frequency-bin boundary in filenames such as 03000-03100 and 03100-03200 cm^-1. A bin boundary is not an exact molecular transition and must remain a control unless an actual line at the target value is separately identified.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Do not promote file-range endpoints to P1.

information_updates.finding: The exact 77596 intersection reinforces the need to retain theoretical and experimental P1 subtypes: the NBS table has a blank observed column and 77596 in the G.L.S. calculated column for that Rh III level.
information_updates.claims_boundary: A calculated value can be a legitimate physical-model quantity while carrying less empirical weight than an observed or evaluated experimental level.
